subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming stay as Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in preset gallery and custom theme studio with a broader persistence contract?
rationale: The current code and docs intentionally expose a narrower customization model, while this issue requests a new maintained in-product authoring surface and settings/persistence behavior.

options.title: Define a core theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Treat the existing tweakcn import slot as the supported customization path and close or narrow the larger studio request.

options.title: Split the feature
options.body: Track preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a core theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the live issue and authored the merged tweakcn import polish PR that defines the current adjacent theming path.
